component.name: NotePad
component.summary: A native GTK4 clone of Microsoft Notepad

description.p: NotePad is a lightweight plain-text editor that recreates the classic Microsoft Notepad (Windows XP) experience using GTK4 and libadwaita, with support for light and dark modes.

ul.li: Open, edit, and save plain text files
Cut, copy, paste, undo, and redo
Find, replace, and go to a line number
Choose an editor font from the Format menu
Word wrap toggle and a live line/column status bar
Insert the current time and date (F5)

description.p: Initial release of the GTK4 NotePad clone.
